column5: configure, loader, ntdll: Support the arm64 macOS address space and app bundles.
makedep: Link the resources of modules built only for the hybrid arch.
ntdll: Skip reserved areas that the alignment rounds past.
ntdll: Run x86 code through FEX on arm64 macOS.
ntdll: Load compatdb.so before the first PE code runs.
ntdll, win32u: Build and run as a self-contained bundle.
ntdll: Let compatdb keep no-exec permanently on.
winemac.drv: Export macdrv_functions for DXMT and mtld3d.

column5: winemac.drv: Fix window and input problems under games, add OpenGL on EGL.
win32u: Fix a window handle race, glyph metrics and painting problems.
kernelbase, winebus.sys, ntdll, loader, winevulkan, winegstreamer: Assorted game fixes.
winecoreaudio.drv, winemac.drv: Request microphone access.
server, ntdll: Add msync.
wined3d: Fix table fog with equal start and end and an Apple GL buffer texture crash.
wined3d: Fix Vulkan renderer spec violations.
wined3d: Add Vulkan fallbacks for P8, windowless swapchains and X8D24.
vkd3d-shader/d3dbc: Synthesize inputs for vs_1_x without dcl.
ddraw/tests: Skip test_map_synchronisation() when the draw time can't be estimated.
winemac.drv: Order child client views by window z-order.
winemac.drv: Show child windows above DXMT and mtld3d client views.
server: Return STATUS_PARTIAL_COPY for writes to read-only memory on macOS.
ntdll: Return FALSE from RtlIsEcCode() above the highest user address.
kernel32/tests: Don't walk the section name if the query fails in test_Wow64Transition.
ntdll: Support QUEUE_USER_APC_CALLBACK_DATA_CONTEXT on ARM64.
ntdll/tests: Skip tests that an x86 emulator on ARM64 can't run.
winemac.drv: Don't use freed startup state when the Cocoa app starts.
win32u: Don't free the display device when it has no context.
win32u: Skip EGL devices without a name in get_opengl_gpus().
win32u: Fall back to eglGetPlatformDisplayEXT() without eglGetPlatformDisplay().
win32u: Only report sRGB pixel formats for EGL configs that have an sRGB variant.
win32u: Give a client surface back once when a framebuffer surface with a target is released.
ntdll: Back up Rip of x64 breakpoints after the debugger saw them on ARM64EC.
win32u: List the virtual modes at the display's own frequency below 60Hz.
server: Complete pending polls when a connect fails under kqueue.
wininet: Connect in non-blocking mode in try_create_connect_socket().
dnsapi: Don't resolve a .local hostname when the DLL loads.
